body.name: simultaneous Wald set
body.construction: If \(\min_{1\le j\le r}|Q_{F,j}(\operatorname{vech}\widehat\Sigma)|=0\) or \(\lambda_{\min}(\widehat V_F)=0\), set \(\mathcal W_{G,N}(1-\gamma)=\mathbb R^r\). On the complementary event, set \(\mathcal W_{G,N}(1-\gamma)=\{t\in\mathbb R^r:N(\widehat\theta_G-t)^{\mathsf T}\widehat V_F^{-1}(\widehat\theta_G-t)\le\chi^2_{r,1-\gamma}\}\).
